summary: The r1 fix is correct and minimal. The search budget only changes the outcome when it runs out. For feasible inputs, forEachDeal returns true whether or not the budget runs out, the RNG is untouched and the sampler is unchanged, so results are identical (old and new builds compared directly on 5 cases). The search undoes its card marks on the way out, so dealt[] is clean when the sampler starts. The card-count check (fewer than 2k distinct live cards means cannotDeal) is a correct necessary condition and keeps the exact error message for the reported 8-opponent broadway case. An infeasible input that exhausts the budget can never have a trial accepted, so it always hits maxRejections and throws (144 ms measured). nodeLimit stays at Infinity on the exact path, which the 200,000-evaluation estimate already bounds. The regression test is strong against the obvious mutations, but if the cap regresses it hangs instead of failing (MINOR). Perf at scale 1 is the same as in r1 (full ring about 70 ms against 80 ms). All advice tests pass. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings; the r1 MAJOR src/advice/equity.ts:unbounded-feasibility-backtrack is fixed.
